mapper.update: update t_glue_schedule_result set release_status = #{releaseStatus}, recipe_type = #{recipeType,jdbcType = VARCHAR}, recipe_version_id = #{recipeVersionId,jdbcType = VARCHAR}, recipe_stage = #{recipeStage,jdbcType = VARCHAR}, formula_weight = #{formulaWeight, jdbcType = DOUBLE}, formula_time = #{formulaTime,jdbcType = DOUBLE} where del_flag = 0 and id = #{id}
mapper.select: select distinct tmpr.recipe_material_name, tmpr.recipe_equip_code, tmpr.mix_area, tmi.machine_name from t_mes_pmt_recipe tmpr left join (select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_mix_machine where del_flag = 0 union select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_lhfl_machine where del_flag = 0) tmi on tmpr.recipe_equip_code = tmi.machine_code and tmpr.mix_area = tmi.mix_area where tmpr.del_flag = 0 AND tmpr.RECIPE_STATE = '1' /*配方状态: 在用*/ AND tmpr.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' /*审核标志： 已审核*/ and tmpr.recipe_material_name = #{recipeMaterialName,jdbcType= VARCHAR} and tmpr.mix_area = #{mixArea,jdbcType= VARCHAR}

select DISTINCT tfm.MIX_AREA, tfm.GLUE, tfm.MACHINE_CODE, tmm.MACHINE_NAME from t_formula_machine tfm left join (select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_mix_machine where del_flag = 0 union select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_lhfl_machine where del_flag = 0) tmm on tmm.MACHINE_CODE = tfm.MACHINE_CODE and tmm.MIX_AREA = tfm.MIX_AREA where tfm.del_flag = 0 and tfm.mix_area = #{mixArea} and tfm.glue = #{glue}

select count(1) from t_glue_schedule_result where del_flag = 0 and release_status != '0' and id in
#{id}

select machine_name, SUM(ifnull(TOTAL_PLAN_QTY, 0)) totalPlanQtyStatistics, SUM(ifnull(TOTAL_SURPLUS, 0)) totalSurplusStatistics, SUM(ifnull(MID_PLAN_QTY, 0)) midPlanQtyStatistics, SUM(ifnull(NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, 0)) nightPlanQtyStatistics, SUM(ifnull(DAY_PLAN_QTY, 0)) dayPlanQtyStatistics from t_glue_schedule_result a left join t_mix_machine b on b.DEL_FLAG = 0 and a.MACHINE_CODE = b.MACHINE_CODE and a.MIX_AREA = b.MIX_AREA where a.DEL_FLAG = 0 and SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} and a.MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} and a.MACHINE_CODE = #{machineCode} group by MACHINE_NAME order by MACHINE_NAME

SELECT SUM(MID_PLAN_QTY) totalMidPlanQty, SUM(NIGHT_PLAN_QTY) totalNightPlanQty, SUM(DAY_PLAN_QTY) totalDayPlanQty FROM T_GLUE_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND MIX_AREA = #{mixArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND MACHINE_CODE = #{machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY MACHINE_CODE
SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PLAN_QTY) FROM t_glue_demand_plan WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND PLAN_DATE = #{scheduleDate}
